summary: REQ-18 and REQ-19 appear largely implemented via a new pointer-follow hook and single-frame sprite viewport rendering in PetOverlay. REQ-20 is partially implemented by updating index.html favicon link and adding a web manifest, but the diff does not show the required icon image assets being added and does not reference a dog favicon.

missing_requirements.requirement: Enable pointer-follow behavior specifically during an active focus/break session (not unconditionally).
missing_requirements.reason: PetOverlay enables pointer-follow unconditionally (`enabled: true`). The diff does not show any gating based on session active state/phase beyond PetOverlay being rendered somewhere else (not evidenced here).

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide the required single-pet pixel-art icon image assets (app icons and favicons for both cat and dog) and ensure references do not point to sprite sheets.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff adds references to `/assets/generated/*.png` in `index.html` and `manifest.webmanifest`, but does not show the actual PNG assets being added/updated. Without the assets present, the acceptance criterion about no missing-icon console errors is not demonstrably met from this diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update favicon/app icon configuration so the browser tab icon uses the new single-pet icon(s) and (if applicable) includes dog favicon as required.
missing_requirements.reason: `index.html` sets the favicon to the cat icon only. The BuildRequest explicitly requires both cat and dog favicon assets; the manifest includes only the cat favicon (64x64) and does not reference a dog favicon.
